Ibiero King IPA 8.2%
Really great hop balance but I’m struggling to pick the flavours. Like there’s a fruit that I just can’t pick. Maybe it just a fruit salad. 8/10
Found this bar next to where my wife was shopping so I could have a beer rather than being bored. Worked out well 

#🍺 #craftbeer #greatbeer #dipa
